claims: The suite can silently run zero tests — `scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:510-516`: the awk `body == 2` rule permits any number of `dispatch_gate_test_families` lines after the closing marker, including none; deleting or relocating the single call at line 7476 leaves `verify_gate_family_partition` passing and the suite exits 0 with no output at all

The partition introduces a single point of failure (a single line whose loss disables everything) and then doesn't check it — a bad rebase or careless edit turns the gate's own self-test into a no-op that reports green

The documented invocation isn't in the repo's agent allowlist — `.claude/settings.json:31-32`: `docs/notes/agent-quality-gate-mechanics.md:1119-1120` documents `GATE_TEST_FOCUS=routing-sources bash scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh`, but the allowlist only carries `Bash(bash scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:*)` and the `./` variant, so the documented focused form prompts

Doc bullet overstates one case — `docs/notes/agent-quality-gate-mechanics.md:1139-1142`: it says `pnpm agent:quality-gate:test` runs in unfocused mode, but it is a bare `bash scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh` (`package.json:20`) so with `GATE_TEST_FOCUS` exported locally it runs focused; drop it from the first bullet's list
